mission.name: Ares Horizon Orbiter
mission.description: Orbital reconnaissance mission to Mars studying ancient fluvial mineralogy, subsurface water ice, and upper atmospheric escape.
mission.primaryObjective: Characterize hydrated mineral deposits and subsurface ice sheets from 400 km Mars orbit.
secondaryObjectives: Map Mars crustal magnetic anomalies across southern highlands
Demonstrate Ka-band high-rate deep-space telemetry downlink
successCriteria: Achieve Mars orbit capture within 10% of nominal 400 km altitude
Collect >= 80% science payload return across primary observation campaigns
Maintain positive power and propellant margins through End of Life disposal

requirements.title: Launch Vehicle Mass Margin
requirements.description: Spacecraft wet mass must remain within selected launch vehicle destination payload capacity.
requirements.objectiveLink: Characterize hydrated mineral deposits and subsurface ice sheets from 400 km Mars orbit.

requirements.title: Positive Power & Eclipse Margin
requirements.description: Power generation at destination solar flux must exceed average bus + payload load with >= 1.2h eclipse battery.
requirements.objectiveLink: Characterize hydrated mineral deposits and subsurface ice sheets from 400 km Mars orbit.

requirements.title: Mission Delta-V Capability
requirements.description: Available Tsiolkovsky delta-v must cover transfer, capture, and contingency maneuvers.
requirements.objectiveLink: Characterize hydrated mineral deposits and subsurface ice sheets from 400 km Mars orbit.

requirements.title: Science Payload Complement
requirements.description: Mission must carry at least 2 compatible instruments with >= 35 aggregate science value.
requirements.objectiveLink: Characterize hydrated mineral deposits and subsurface ice sheets from 400 km Mars orbit.

requirements.title: Budget Cap & Contingency
requirements.description: Total estimated cost including risk mitigations must stay within the mission budget cap.
requirements.objectiveLink: Map Mars crustal magnetic anomalies across southern highlands

requirements.title: Critical Risk Mitigation
requirements.description: All Critical (score >= 16) mission risks must be mitigated before Flight Readiness Review.
requirements.objectiveLink: Achieve Mars orbit capture within 10% of nominal 400 km altitude

risks.title: Propellant Margin Depletion During Orbit Capture
risks.description: Navigation dispersion or finite-burn gravity losses could require additional delta-v at arrival.
risks.mitigationStrategy: Carry >= 10% delta-v propellant reserve and verify optical navigation updates prior to MOI.

risks.title: Solar / Thermal Power Deficit in Eclipse or Low Flux
risks.description: Reduced irradiance at destination or dust accumulation drops array output below essential bus load.
risks.mitigationStrategy: Upgrade to triple-junction GaAs arrays or RTG and size batteries for 4+ hour eclipse survival.

risks.title: Deep-Space Telemetry Link Blackout
risks.description: High-gain antenna pointing drift or solar conjunction degrades science data downlink.
risks.mitigationStrategy: Add Ka-band redundant transponder and autonomous safe-mode sun/Earth acquisition.

risks.title: Launch Fairing Vibro-Acoustic Overload
risks.description: Max-Q acoustic pressure stresses sensitive optical baffles and deployable booms.
risks.mitigationStrategy: Perform full acoustic chamber qualification and reinforce deployment latches.

gates.name: Critical Design Review
blockedReasons: 2 Critical risk(s) remain unmitigated in the Risk Register.
1 Mandatory requirement(s) currently failing verification.

blockedReasons: 2 Critical risk(s) remain unmitigated in the Risk Register.

gates.name: Post-Flight Assessment Review
